mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a positive predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income, regardless of the current rate level.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is observed, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 280.0 signals persistent inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 280.0), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 280.0) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals an economic recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 280.0 AND UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 280.0), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.3% increase in the last month) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where CPIAUCSL > 280.0, UNRATE rises by more than 0.3% in the last month, but SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1600.0 (HOUST > 1600.0) signals strong economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1600.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO > 100.0) signals robust economic output and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in employment (PAYEMS > 0.5% increase in the last month) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE < 0.2% decrease in the last month) signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 0.5% AND UNRATE < 0.2%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 280.0), a high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 620000.0) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with strong consumer demand regime
failure_condition: In instances where CPIAUCSL > 280.0, RSAFS > 620000.0, but SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
